records.summary: Qatar's prime minister/foreign minister visited Tehran and met Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, moving the mediation track from calls into an in-person session focused on Hormuz, de-escalation and conditions for renewed dialogue.
Kpler counted 10 visible commodity-vessel Hormuz transits on Wednesday, Aug. 26, up from eight Tuesday but still below the 10-day moving average of about 15.
As Qatar mediated in Tehran, parliament speaker Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf framed U.S. pressure as an 'all-out economic war' and called for national unity.
